overview: Kazuaki is troubled by the lack of intimacy with his live-in lover. Meanwhile, Sei, his childhood friend and co-worker who lives with him, harbors unrequited feelings for Kazuaki. One day, Kazuaki's email is mistakenly delivered to Sei, and they continue to have a strange relationship where they confide their worries to each other by email, without knowing each other's true identities. This is the ultimate love story of two people at the mercy of unrequited love and sex.
title: When It Rains, It Pours

overview: Megumi Yotsugi, a student at Eichi University, encounters a beautiful woman, Kotoha Furuhashi, who has been abandoned in a garbage dump. After inviting Kotoha to her home, Megumi hopes to become friends with her. However, Kotoha proposes an unusual arrangement: they will act as "lovers" until Megumi can guess her real name. The two make a peculiar bet—if Megumi succeeds in guessing Kotoha's name during their temporary relationship, they will become friends as originally intended. Unable to back out, Megumi grows closer to Kotoha as they play the roles of lovers. However, the hidden past tied to Kotoha's name begins to surface, threatening their bond.
title: Call Me By No Name

overview: Denise Létourneau and Dominique André, two roommates and two very good friends, live in an apartment building in Montreal, Canada. They live crazy adventures, often initiated by Denise.
title: Moi... et l'autre

overview: When 69-year-old Cha Hsia's grandson announces his intention to undergo a sex change, Cha Hsia accidentally falls down the stairs with him, and his soul then enters the youthful body of his grandson. From that day on, he experiences many firsts in his grandson's body: going to college, living in a dormitory, being kissed by a man, and falling in love. Does the classmate the grandson secretly admires actually like him back? In the dormitory, his grandson's boyfriend even takes off his pants and wants to… Who is the red thread of fate connected to?
title: The Promise of the Soul

overview: Straight from the world of LOL comes LOL Talent Show: Chi fa ridere è dentro! Get ready for a barrage of aspiring comedians and an exciting contest hosted by Forest, the magician! Three judges: Elio, Katia Follesa, and Angelo Pintus. Their mission? To find the tenth contestant for LOL 4! They'll travel through Italy and be assisted by a different guest judge on every episode.
title: LOL Talent Show: Chi fa ridere è dentro

overview: A man carrying a black duffel bag entered a clinic. By the day's end, two women were dead, and a search for the culprit was afoot.
title: The Basement Talks
Marconi - L'uomo che ha connesso il mondo

overview: Evolve and Flex with sports-lifestyle host and style guru Lance Fresh is a series that dives deep into personal fashion journeys, uncovering how life experiences have shaped and transformed each guest's style evolution. The show highlights pivotal moments and influences that have impacted their fashion choices, offering a fresh perspective on how life and fashion intersect -- while also showcasing the powerful connection between sports and style.
title: Evolve and Flex with Lance Fresh

overview: A young generation of artists inspired by their English and German neighbors is determined to revolutionize art: Victor Hugo, George Sand, Honoré de Balzac, Alexandre Dumas, Eugène Delacroix, Gérard de Nerval, Charles Baudelaire ... While the people in the streets rumble and clamor for the Republic, the Romantics will not rest until freedom is in power. Their works and ideas will fundamentally transform French society.
title: L'Armée des Romantiques

overview: Born with shamanic powers that she refuses to accept, a young woman confronts her gift to rid the Joseon palace of evil spirits and save her first love.
title: The Haunted Palace

overview: Yoon Joo-no, a key figure in the former M&A Team of SANIN GROUP, suddenly disappeared one day, leaving for Hawaii for undisclosed reasons. Rumors spread that he had been demoted, but the truth remains unknown to anyone. Then, three years later, when SANIN GROUP is facing bankruptcy with 11 billion dollars in debt, he is called back to Korea as their last hope. His mission is clear: to save SANIN GROUP. However, his solution is far from straightforward. Gaining the support of CEO Song Jae-sik, he forms a new M&A Team and gathers the best negotiators to dive into the perilous world of high-stakes deals. With his team, Joo-no takes one last gamble. Can he secure the 11 billion dollars needed to save the company, or will even the so-called "god of negotiation" be brought down?
title: The Art of Negotiation

overview: Kim Seong-Jun (Kim Soo-Hyun) is regular office worker, but, after the IMF crisis, he lost his job and began working the counterfeit market. He begins to work as the vice chairman of a counterfeit producing company and grows the company into one of the largest counterfeiters in the world. He relies on his intelligence, quick response to unexpected situations, and a strong desire for success to become the king of the counterfeit market. Meanwhile, Song Hye-Jeong (Jo Bo-Ah) is Kim Seong-Jun's ex-girlfriend and she works as a special judicial police officer, whose job is to crack down on counterfeit goods. Kim Seong-Jun and Song Hye-Jeong form a tense relationship surrounding the crackdown of counterfeit goods.
title: Knock Off

overview: A human thriller that takes place when a housewife in her 40s with a sick husband accidentally picks up drugs that fell on the road.
title: Walking on Thin Ice

overview: A thriller that follows a woman who was imprisoned as a serial killer a long time ago, and someone begins a serial killing imitating her.
title: Queen Mantis

overview: Traverse the planet's richest, most diverse woodlands, from the tropics to the poles and everywhere in between. Get to know the wild residents of these magical ecosystems and learn how forests connect and nurture the lives of countless species.
title: Inside the Enchanted Forests

overview: The Last Tycoon is based on F. Scott Fitzgerald's final unfinished novel and is inspired by the life of film mogul Irving Thalberg, on whom the book's protagonist Monroe Stahr was based. The Last Tycoon centers on Stahr, Hollywood's first wunderkind studio executive in the 1930's as he climbs to the height of power pitting him against his mentor and current head of the studio Pat Brady, a character based on Louis B. Mayer. With Stahr as a focal point, the series delves into the true violence, sex and towering ambition of Hollywood in the '30's.
title: The Last Tycoon

overview: Following the inexplicable sinking of a trawler and its fishermen who remain untraceable, Abigail, an oceanographer, is sent by IFREMER on a mission to Fécamp, her hometown, which she left a few years earlier following a family tragedy. As her research progresses, new mysterious phenomena occur at sea, making the activity of fishermen, although essential to local life, impossible. Abigail will learn that these disasters could originate from an underwater presence capable of upsetting the fragile balance between man and nature... What if the cause of the disturbances does not correspond to anything known?
title: Rivages

overview: After the climate disaster, women spend their pregnancy in the Sanctuary, a dome with improved climate conditions. There they live in peace, cared for and relaxed, away from their families and the rest of society to prevent the polluted air from affecting the pregnancy.
title: Santuario

overview: This four-part documentary series, adapted from Eric Lemasson's book, explores one of the biggest criminal mysteries of the last twenty years, following the trail of the missing family, from Normandy to the north of Scotland, via Saint-Malo and the Isle of Man. The investigation links this family drama to the assassination, in 2001, of the emblematic leader of a small traders' union, the CDCA, by professional killers. The tragic story of the doctor who decided to drop everything to change his life intersects with the mafia nebula surrounding this "anti-system" union.
title: Docteur Godard - l'homme qui voulait tout quitter

overview: Men and women who gathered to get the best love. However, among the members, one or more "liar" wolves who do not fall in love are lurking in either the man or the woman.
title: Who is a Wolf?

overview: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.
title: Saving Grace

overview: It tells the story of a prince stationed at the frontier, who received a secret order from the crown prince and rushed to Yuncheng with his cavalry. However, he was ambushed by the secret guards as soon as he arrived at the gate, and was inexplicably accused of treason. After a fierce fight, he finally escaped, but he was turned into a child. As a child with a body of only 10 years old, how can he solve the mystery step by step, and how can he survive the pursuit?
title: True Love Moon

overview: An assassination attempt triggers a soul-swap between divorcing couple Xiao Jingyang and Lin Mingxuan - sending them back to pre-wedding days! While cooperating to reverse the swap, their unresolved tensions flare. Just as their bodies return and truths emerge, Xiao pushes Lin away… only for her to uncover his secret. Now, with hidden forces stirring and death looming, Lin vows to stand by Xiao against all odds.
title: Love Rewritten

overview: The Interestings is described as a grounded character-driven drama based on Wolitzer's novel about a group of friends who meet at an arts camp when they're 15 in 1974. The series chronicles their relationships throughout the next three decades dealing with the great expectations of youth juxtaposed with the realities life hands you as you get older.
title: The Interestings

overview: Cosme and Damião earn their living selling candy on the street – it is the megalomania of the first combined with the innocence of the second that will lead them to the biggest robberies in Realengo.
title: Cosme & Damião: Quase Santos

overview: Gassal tells the story of a gassal who pursues the question "Who will wash me when I die?" and tells the story of Baki, who decides to reshape his life after coming face to face with death. Living side by side with death as a gassal, Baki discovers new meanings about life while looking for someone to wash him. The series invites the audience to both think and understand the value of life, while also offering an enjoyable experience with humorous elements here and there.
title: Gassal

overview: The life of successful lawyer and law school professor Marta Orlova changes dramatically in just one day. She discovers that her fiancé and colleague, Artem, is cheating on her, and her stepfather, the head of Marta's firm who raised her after her mother's death, sides with Artem, claiming Marta's marriage to the son of General Nikolsky is beneficial to both families. Finding herself without support or the ability to continue working with her stepfather and Artem, Marta decides to open her own law firm, focusing on helping people who are unable to afford legal services.
title: Социальная защита

overview: Arman Alizad's documentary series takes viewers to the edge of the world and explores what humanity is doing right and what is wrong. Human influence on the world has expanded so widely with the development of technology and science that in 2008, Vatican Archbishop Gianfranco Girrotti named the new deadly sins of the modern world. Inspired by these, Arman Alizad has examined the injustices that prevail in our world and wonders if they are really sins.
title: Arman ja 7 kuolemansyntiä

overview: Three generations of the Ottink family work together on one farm. Each has a different vision for the future of their beloved dairy farm. Woeste Grond shows the emotional and recognizable dynamics of a farming family balancing tradition and modernity.
title: Woeste Grond

overview: After his wife's death, Mehmet, a successful lawyer, begins to face challenges with his daughter, Doğa. Holding her father responsible for her mother's death, Doğa, fueled by the turbulence of adolescence, subjects him to intense emotional strain. The tension between them peaks when Doğa attempts suicide. Meanwhile, the seemingly perfect marriage of Handan and Celal suffers a major blow on their 25th wedding anniversary. A seed of doubt is planted in Handan's mind, making her suspect that her husband might be unfaithful. Despite her attempts to dismiss this suspicion, a phone call confirming her fears marks the beginning of the end for her. Mehmet, desperate to save his daughter from her suicidal path, and Handan, heading to confront her husband at a hotel, cross paths in a cruel twist of fate.
title: Can Borcu

overview: Longitude is an extraordinary true story of adventure, intrigue and power on the high seas of 18th century England.
title: Longitude

overview: Kiefer Sutherland stars as Tom Kirkman, a lower-level cabinet member who is suddenly appointed President of the United States after a catastrophic attack on the US Capitol during the State of the Union, on the highly anticipated series Designated Survivor. In this dramatic thriller, Kirkman will struggle to keep the country and his own family from falling apart, while navigating the highly-volatile political arena and while leading the search to find who is responsible for the attack.
title: Designated Survivor

overview: Knockout will take an unflinching look at the life of legendary boxer and cultural icon Mike Tyson. Known as the youngest heavyweight champion in history (at the age of 20 in 1986), Tyson's legacy extends far beyond the ropes of the boxing ring, cementing him as one of the most compelling and polarizing figures of our time. From his meteoric rise as the "Baddest Man on the Planet" to his personal struggles – including a period of incarceration and widely publicized struggles (i.e. finances, substance abuse, in-ring controversies) – and eventual redemption, this series will explore the man behind the gloves.
title: Knockout

overview: Julie Andrieu travels across various regions in France and explores their landscape, culture and culinary heritage.
title: Les Carnets de Julie

overview: Great Migrations: A People on the Move tells the story of African American movement over the 20th and 21st centuries, and how it has shaped our nation by exploring the meaning behind those movements. What political or economic pressures inspire people to move? Is it more often inspired by hope or fear? Is there even such a thing as a promised land? Human beings have always moved en masse. Since the beginning of human existence, movement has defined how we evolved and created identities, communities, and nations-states. Migration is not unique to any single ethnicity or group, but it is a deeply profound aspect of the modern African American experience simply because Black people were denied movement for so long. Theirs was a forced migration from Africa, followed by centuries of enslavement that kept them in place. In being denied movement, they were denied their humanity. After emancipation, the migratory spirit took hold in this new space of freedom, and many African Americans uprooted themselves from all that was familiar to move to northern cities (sometimes stopping first in southern cities) to build entirely new lives – a decision that dramatically changed the fabric of American culture and society. It was an epic migration of people that began in the late 19th century when it was clear that the early promises of Reconstruction would not be fulfilled, and accelerated as the century progressed. Underlying this courageous act was the abiding belief in American opportunity, as well as a belief in their own capacity to better their lives, and the lives of their children. In some ways, it has never really ended.
title: Great Migrations: A People on the Move

overview: The Pet Rescuers follows the work of a team on a mission to give abandoned pets a second chance.
title: The Pet Rescuers

overview: Prospective buyers look to make their dream of living by the ocean a reality as they hunt for oceanfront properties along the Atlantic coastline. Who doesn't dream of living by the ocean? Oceanfront Property Hunt follows prospective buyers looking to purchase their first oceanfront home. Our buyers are families from all walks of life. In some episodes, we'll meet people looking for a unique fixer-upper. Or we'll follow their search for a modest family home. Other folks want a spacious, turn-key dream home along the rugged coastline.
title: Oceanfront Property Hunt

overview: Tracing the rise and fall of the Roman Empire over 500 years through the public and private lives of six of the Empire's rulers.
title: I, Caesar

overview: Witness cooking like never before as celebrities take over the kitchen station with hosts Farah Khan, Ranveer Brar and Vikas Khanna.
title: Celebrity MasterChef

overview: On Laem Sing Beach in the Buddhist era 2540 (1997), on a day when the grey sky portended a coming storm, Kamol gave birth to Suricha in the middle of a fishing boat. In the depths below them was the shadow of a great serpent waiting to give its blessing. Kamol did not survive, however, and Suricha was raised by a single father. Fifteen years later, out of nowhere, Suricha loses another important figure in her life to suicide. There was only a tuft of fiery red hair by her father's body. In Chanthaburi 2565 (2022), twenty-five-year-old Suricha is a beautician with particular skills. When she touches someone's hair, she sees numbers related to their fate. When that skill gives her the knowledge to help the salon of a famous makeup artist out of its plight, she gains the disfavour of the manager Yukha.
title: Naka De Salon

overview: When Sergeant Rousseau loses another double agent to organized crime, she has no choice but to try a new approach. Rather than hiring recruits, she turns to Adam and Mounir, two Maghrebian actors who will become double agents for a top-secret police division where, thanks to their acting talent.
title: Double Jeu

overview: When Cape Town housewife Christelle Smit discovers evidence her husband is having an affair with a stripper named Candy Floss, her investigation takes her to a world poles apart from the suburban utopia she knows.
title: Koek
May Your Heart Be Like Mine

overview: Valerio Zeno receives a group of singles at Paradise Hotel, where one hotel rule applies: either you share a room or you check out. At check-in, the participants indicated whether they came for money or love. Blooming loves, broken hearts and new friendships that are put to the test: who can withstand that and knows how to hold out until the end?
title: Paradise Hotel

overview: When Brussels resident Gigi discovers that his mother Anaïs is dating her ex Fabrice again, with whom she shared a drug addiction in the past, in addition to love, he gives her an ultimatum: her son or her lover.
title: Putain

overview: A continuation of the movie Homestead... Amid chaos, ex-Green Beret joins prepper compound; love grows, truths arise, and a community unites.
title: Homestead: The Series

overview: Bill Henrickson seems like a typical suburban husband and father, except for the fact that he has three wives, seven kids and three homes to maintain. The Salt Lake City polygamist has to juggle his families' needs while overseeing his growing chain of home-improvement stores and attempting to reconnect with his fundamentalist relatives.
title: Big Love

overview: Years ago, Shen Qingru's mother was drowned for adultery by the clan leader. Branded as the daughter of a "fallen woman," Qingru grew up numb and tormented under the town's scorn, carrying the weight of her mother's tragic fate. Then came Shen Cheng—the "mute" boy who became both her salvation and her greatest weakness. Their bond blurred the fragile line of "siblings," yet the world's gaze kept it firmly in place. Under watchful eyes, Qingru swore with tears that she would never fall in love. Forced into marriage to bring luck to the ailing Mo family heir, Qingru was left widowed the night before the wedding. The Mo matriarch demanded she be buried with him. Meanwhile, Shen Cheng was lured into a deadly trap. To save him, Qingru married the seemingly "gentle" son of the clan leader. Left for dead in a mass grave, Shen Cheng miraculously survived. Years later, the once "mute and rugged" young man returned as a cold and powerful marshal, hiding his true identity as he stepped back into the town—only for her.
title: Burning Passion

overview: Wei Jianhao, a young man with the unique identify stone ability "Jade Buddha Hand," returns to Chongjiang and is forced into the conflict between the Tang and Gu families, constantly facing challenges from skilled opponents. Unable to stand idly by as the Jade Street faces danger, he uses his extraordinary abilities to navigate the treacherous situation, transitioning from wanting to escape to fully protecting it, fighting for justice in a world full of twists and turns.
title: The Gold Behind the Stone

overview: Set in an alternate reality, Hide Games unravels around a mystery case—the murder of a narcotics officer. Packed with nonstop thrills, the series delves deep into the clash between good and evil. Beyond the excitement of piecing together every clue, it explores the complexity of human nature as shocking truths gradually come to light.
title: Hide Games

overview: Veteran district attorney J.L. "Fatman" McCabe solves cases with the help of his easygoing private investigator partner Jake Styles.
title: Jake and the Fatman

overview: Reflecting the extraordinary lives of some of the famous faces and notable figures who we lost in the last year. Friends, fans and family share their treasured memories.
title: Lives Well Lived

overview: The Bozo Show was the longest running show on WGN-TV Chicago. It featured the cast of the original shows with sketches, cartoons (such as Rocky and Bullwinkle), a miniture game show called "Bozo's Grand Prize Game", and fun stuffs. In 1995, The show was relegated to weekends only and the show renamed as "The Bozo Super Weekend Show".
title: The Bozo Show

overview: The documentary presents Hungary's special and unique natural phenomena, living creatures and plants in the areas where everything is done to preserve the original wilderness.
title: A megőrzött vadon

overview: After triumphing in the Russian Cup, head coach Marko Nikolić unexpectedly leaves the club, and CSKA Moscow appoints swiss coach Fabio Celestini as his successor. Within just a few months, he transforms the team and restores its belief in winning the league title. For the first time in ten years, CSKA are once again among the main contenders for the championship. But real football begins where the broadcast ends. The cameras go behind the scenes, into the dressing room, the training ground and the players' homes. Viewers will discover why Nikolić left the club and learn how the careers of legendary CSKA captain Igor Akinfeev, young talents Matvey Kislyak and Kirill Glebov, and many other players on the team unfolded.
title: Мама, мы – ЦСКА!

overview: A Taipei doctor and a San Francisco engineer swap homes in a daring pact, embarking on journeys filled with trials, secrets and unexpected encounters.
title: A Taiwanese Tale of Two Cities

overview: Detective Captain Gu Zhen leads his team in investigating a series of crimes, solving complex cases with his sharp instincts and intelligence. Meanwhile, he discovers that he has become the target of revenge orchestrated by the family of a past victim. To protect the people and his loved ones, Gu Zhen confronts a vengeful adversary who has embraced darkness. In the end, justice prevails, and the criminals receive the punishment they deserve.
title: Criminal Scene

overview: Philippe leads a private detective agency founded by his father. His hazardous management of the business forces his father to impose a new partner on his son: Nora, a former intelligence officer. Two opposing personalities, two investigative methods!
title: Détectives

overview: Put on your sparkliest outfit! Sophie Ellis-Bextor hosts an unforgettable night of disco bliss, with classic dance floor anthems and very special guests to keep the party going.
title: Sophie Ellis-Bextor's New Year's Eve Disco

overview: Phlapphla, who works as a writer, has to look after her brother Tong on her own and without the help of Treepradub, their eldest sister who married a wealthy man and never gave her a hand. One day, Tong has an argument with Pheem's brother who is later knocked unconscious by Tong. This causes Phlapphla and Pheem to meet, and their first meeting is disastrous as she slaps him across his face. However, Phlapphla is at a disadvantage due to his sister's assault case, so Pheem gives an offer to become his woman in order to save her sibling.
title: Game of Love

overview: Bai Xiao Duo, who is used to protecting herself with lies because of her low self-esteem, meets Su Yan Cheng, a genius cartoonist who is very disgusted with lies in the college community. Such different people healed each other in a series of events and gradually healed each other's inner wounds.
title: City of Romance

overview: The six-part drama directed by Tereza Kopáčová based on a script by Miro Šifra and Kristina Májová returns to a love story that traumatized several generations of Czechoslovaks. What preceded the infamous family tragedy of 1968? What followed it? Where can disrupted relationships in a closed rural community lead? What do we take with us as an inner legacy from our parents?
title: Studna

overview: Archaeologist Miriam Cooke and Egyptologist Dominic Montserrat attempt to unravel some of the most intriguing mysteries which the ancient Egyptian race have left behind.
title: Egypt Detectives

overview: Twenty people under one roof, $1 million dollars in prizes up for grabs. To win it, they've GOT TO GET OUT…but that's much easier said than done. Lies and lunacy collide in this exhilarating competition series where an outrageous mix of reality icons and crafty gamers must conspire to get out. In this house, time is money. As the clock ticks up, so does the prize money. The longer they stay, the greater their chance to earn more. They can split the money equally in the end, or at any point in time, try to make their escape with the accumulated money all for themselves, leaving others to start again at $0. From wild strategies and temptations to shifting alliances and unbelievable escape attempts, the players will try any and every way to make it out of the gate and win the prize.
title: Got to Get Out

overview: The story unfolds as Zhou Na, a modern-day mystery novelist, finds herself serendipitously transported to ancient Yan City, where she becomes the fiancée of County Magistrate Guo Zijie. Together, they repeatedly solve bizarre cases. As their mutual affection deepens and their bond grows stronger, a sinister conspiracy involving life and death silently emerges...
title: Cao Xuanxuan's Love Journey

overview: As people and governments around the world come to terms with the reality of the UFO phenomenon, top experts in science, philosophy, religious studies, and more are grappling with its implications for humanity. Cosmosis: UFOs & A New Reality explores how these revelations challenge our understanding of history, non-human intelligence, and the future. Through interviews with leading researchers and experiencers, this docuseries uncovers the latest evidence and theories, offering a fresh perspective on how these discoveries could reshape society and our place in the cosmos.
title: Cosmosis: UFOs & A New Reality

overview: Two brothers, Joe and Trevor Purvis (Robson Green and Stephen Tompkinson) work together to renovate a house for a London couple. The building part is easy, but working together is another story.
title: Grafters
